mapper.sql: agent_results_json IS NOT NULL AND agent_results_json <> '' AND agent_results_json <> 'null' AND agent_results_json <> '{}' AND agent_results_json <> '[]' AND JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.images') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.images')) <> 'NULL' AND ( ( JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.images')) = 'ARRAY' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.images')) > 0 ) OR ( JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.images')) = 'OBJECT' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.images')) > 0 ) )

CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.images')) = 'ARRAY' THEN IFNULL(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.images')), 0) WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.images')) = 'OBJECT' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.images')) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

where.if: AND ( sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT id, sku, product_name AS productName, () AS imageCount, () AS coverUrl, NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.batchNo')), '') AS batchNo, COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.generatedAt')), ''), NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.createdAt')), '') ) AS generatedAt, update_date AS updateDate FROM t_gigab2b_product_list
ORDER BY update_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT id, sku, product_name AS productName, () AS imageCount, () AS coverUrl, NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.batchNo')), '') AS batchNo, COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.generatedAt')), ''), NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agent_results_json, '$.createdAt')), '') ) AS generatedAt, update_date AS updateDate, agent_results_json AS agentResultsJson FROM t_gigab2b_product_list WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
